test_name: Sign in with the wrong password
test_description: Refusal must not reveal whether the address has an account
test_precondition: A registered and verified account exists
step_description: Sign in with a valid email address and an incorrect password
step_expected_result: Sign-in is refused. The message is "Email or password is incorrect." and no session is created

test_name: Sign in with an unknown email
test_description: The same refusal as a wrong password so addresses cannot be probed
test_precondition: No account exists for the address used
step_description: Sign in with an address that has no account and any password
step_expected_result: Sign-in is refused with the identical message used for a wrong password, so the response cannot be used to discover which addresses are registered

test_name: Sign in with an empty password
test_precondition: A registered account exists
step_description: Submit the sign-in form with a valid email and the password field left blank
step_expected_result: The form refuses to submit and a field-level error is shown on the password field. No request is sent

test_name: Sign-in attempts are rate limited
test_precondition: A registered account exists
step_description: Submit eleven consecutive failed sign-in attempts for the same address within fifteen minutes
step_expected_result: The eleventh attempt is refused as rate limited rather than as a wrong password, and remains refused until the window passes

test_name: Register with an address that already has an account
test_precondition: An account already exists for the address
step_description: Submit the registration form using an email address that already has an account
step_expected_result: Registration is refused with a conflict and a field-level error on the email address

test_name: Register with a password that is too short
test_precondition: Registration is open
step_description: Submit the registration form with a password of fewer than ten characters
step_expected_result: Registration is refused with a field-level error on the password field stating the minimum length

test_name: Verify with an incorrect code
test_precondition: An account has been registered and is awaiting verification
step_description: Submit a six-digit verification code that does not match the one issued
step_expected_result: The code is refused and the account remains unverified

test_name: Verify with an incorrect code
test_precondition: An account has been registered and is awaiting verification
step_description: Submit an incorrect code six times
step_expected_result: After five attempts the code is refused outright, and a correct code supplied afterwards is also refused

test_name: Verify with an expired code
test_precondition: An account has been registered and is awaiting verification. The clock can be advanced
step_description: Advance the clock more than fifteen minutes past the moment the code was issued and submit the correct code
step_expected_result: The code is refused as expired and the account remains unverified

test_name: Create an alarm ending before it starts
test_precondition: Signed in
step_description: Create an alarm with an end date earlier than its start date
step_expected_result: Creation is refused with a field-level error on the end date. No alarm is created

test_name: Create an alarm with an invalid time of day
test_precondition: Signed in
step_description: Create an alarm with a time of day of 24:00
step_expected_result: Creation is refused. Times run from 00:00 to 23:59 and 24:00 is not a valid time

test_name: Create an alarm with an unknown timezone
test_precondition: Signed in
step_description: Create an alarm with a timezone that is not a valid IANA name
step_expected_result: Creation is refused with a field-level error on the timezone

test_name: Create a weekly alarm with no weekday chosen
test_precondition: Signed in
step_description: Create an alarm with a weekly rule and no weekday selected
step_expected_result: Creation is refused. A weekly rule with no day selected has no occurrences

test_name: Create an alarm with an interval outside the permitted range
test_precondition: Signed in
step_description: Create an alarm with an interval rule of 0 and then of 366
step_expected_result: Both are refused with a field-level error. The permitted range is 1 to 365

test_name: Create two alarms with the same name in one group
test_precondition: Signed in with at least one group
step_description: Create an alarm in a group using the name of an alarm that already exists in that group
step_expected_result: Creation is refused with a conflict and a field-level error on the name

test_name: Create two alarms with the same name in one group
test_precondition: Signed in with at least one group
step_description: Repeat using the same name with different capitalisation and surrounding spaces
step_expected_result: Creation is refused again. Names are compared case-insensitively, after trimming

test_name: Create two alarms that fire at the same instant
test_precondition: Signed in with one enabled alarm already created
step_description: Create a second enabled alarm whose schedule produces the same instant as an existing enabled alarm within the next ninety days
step_expected_result: Creation is refused with a conflict that names the colliding alarm and the instant they share

test_name: Create two alarms that fire at the same instant
test_precondition: Signed in with one enabled alarm already created
step_description: Disable the existing alarm and create the same second alarm again
step_expected_result: Creation succeeds. A disabled alarm is invisible to the collision rule

test_name: Create an alarm with a voice but no message
test_precondition: Signed in
step_description: Create an alarm with a voice preference selected and the spoken message left empty
step_expected_result: Creation is refused with a field-level error asking for a message or no voice

test_name: Create an alarm with a voice but no message
test_precondition: Signed in
step_description: Create an alarm whose spoken message is only whitespace
step_expected_result: Creation is refused. A blank message is not the same as no message

test_name: A disabled alarm does not fire
test_precondition: Signed in, notifications permitted, an alarm due within the lookahead
step_description: Disable an alarm whose next occurrence falls inside the next two minutes and wait past that moment
step_expected_result: No notification is raised and nothing is spoken

test_name: Create a group with a name already in use
test_precondition: Signed in with at least one group
step_description: Create a group using the name of an existing group
step_expected_result: Creation is refused with a conflict and a field-level error on the name. The dialog stays open with the text still in it

test_name: Rename a group to a name already in use
test_precondition: Signed in with at least two groups
step_description: Rename one group to the exact name of another
step_expected_result: The rename is refused with a conflict and the original name is unchanged

test_name: Delete a group without confirming
test_precondition: Signed in with a group that contains at least one alarm
step_description: Request deletion of a group that holds alarms without supplying the confirmation flag
step_expected_result: Deletion is refused and the response carries the number of alarms that would have been deleted. The group and its alarms remain

test_name: Two ungrouped alarms with the same name
test_precondition: Signed in with one ungrouped alarm
step_description: Create a second alarm with no group using the name of an existing ungrouped alarm
step_expected_result: Creation is refused with a conflict. Ungrouped alarms share one namespace

test_name: Two ungrouped alarms with the same name
test_precondition: Signed in with one ungrouped alarm
step_description: Create an alarm with that same name inside a group
step_expected_result: Creation succeeds. The name is only taken among ungrouped alarms, not across the account

test_name: Reach another account's alarm
test_precondition: Two accounts exist and each has at least one alarm
step_description: Signed in as the first account request the second account's alarm by its identifier
step_expected_result: The alarm is reported as not found rather than forbidden, so identifiers cannot be probed for existence

test_name: Reach another account's alarm
test_precondition: Two accounts exist and each has at least one alarm
step_description: Attempt to edit and then delete that alarm
step_expected_result: Both are refused and the alarm is unchanged

test_name: Act without a session
test_precondition: Signed out
step_description: Request the alarm list while signed out
step_expected_result: The request is refused as unauthenticated

test_name: Act without a session
test_precondition: Signed out
step_description: Open an application page directly by its address while signed out
step_expected_result: The browser is sent to the sign-in page rather than shown the application

test_name: Edit an alarm into a collision
test_precondition: Signed in with two enabled alarms at different times
step_description: Edit the second alarm so that its schedule produces the same instant as the first
step_expected_result: The change is refused with a conflict naming the other alarm. The alarm keeps its previous schedule
